spanish: Y si no alcanzare su mano bastancia de oveja, y traerá su culpa que pecó, dos tórtolas o dos hijos de paloma a Jehová, uno a pecado y uno a holocausto.

findings.issue: H7716 is one animal of the flock (sheep or goat), singular and not sex-specific; oveja narrows it to a sheep.
H2403 covers sin and sin-offering; pecado keeps only sin, while the paired H5930 is rendered as the offering holocausto.

notes: Other tokens match, including 3fs hand as subject, 3ms bring/sin, two birds, hijos de paloma, and Jehová.
